{{Quote|Spacers' tales told of massive Mandalorian war fleets lurking in the dark beyond the Rim, but for a decade the Republic did little but watch and wait, even as Neo-Crusader raids imperiled worlds from Corsin to Azure|From [[Vilnau Teupt]]'s "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]," [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
[[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] once '''raided''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Azure/Legends|Azure]]. Before [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] directly harassed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] forces in [[3965 BBY]], they raided systems outside the Republic's territory. This went on for most of a decade after they [[Battle of Cathar|devastated]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]] in [[3973 BBY]], and during this time they attacked Azure.

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], [[Vilnau Teupt]] delivered the [[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul|keynote address]] at the four-hundred-twelfth [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]], in which he spoke on the Mandalorian race's development, mentioned the raiding of Azure during his overview of the Mandalorian War.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was referenced in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.
